name: OoD-Bench-plus
description: OoD-Bench-plus evaluates models' robustness to out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs by measuring detection of OOD samples and drops in predictive performance under distribution shift. It aggregates OOD scenarios across datasets and modalities (depending on implementation) to assess calibration, uncertainty estimation, and classification robustness. The benchmark is intended to highlight failure modes and compare OOD detection methods under standardized metrics.
reputation: Niche dataset aimed at robustness/OOD research with modest adoption in the vision/robustness community.
